title: A Multi-Task Architecture on Relevance-based Neural Query Translation
answer_short: We compute the ratio of the probability of seeing a translation term in TC and RC to measure balance.
answer_rationale: The quantitative analysis involves calculating the ratio of probabilities of translation terms appearing in the Translation Corpus (TC) versus the Retrieval Corpus (RC) to assess translation balance, as explicitly described in block 23.
